description:
This modern apartment, situated in the desirable area of Mijas Costa, Malaga, presents a unique opportunity to enjoy contemporary living on the Costa del Sol. Comprising two well-proportioned bedrooms and two stylish bathrooms, the property offers a comfortable built area of 98.97m², with an inviting interior space of 59.99m² complemented by a private terrace spanning 15.75m². The apartment is brand new, designed to the highest standards with a focus on both practicality and luxury.

Among its standout features, the apartment boasts air conditioning for year-round comfort, fitted wardrobes to maximise storage, and an open plan kitchen seamlessly connecting to the living area. The inclusion of a laundry room adds further convenience, while the security entrance ensures peace of mind. The property is also equipped with an automatic irrigation system, maintaining the external areas with minimal effort.

The living experience is further enhanced by a selection of terraces, both covered and uncovered, enabling residents to enjoy the outdoor spaces regardless of the season. The private terrace offers panoramic views, capturing both the tranquil sea and the picturesque mountains that define the region’s landscape.

Occupants benefit from enviable proximity to the sea and beach, as well as a wide range of amenities, restaurants, and leisure options located nearby. This apartment is ideally positioned for those seeking a blend of relaxation, convenience, and modern sophistication in one of Malaga’s most sought-after coastal communities.
